results.desc:
PHASES is a three track EP shaped by contrast, emotion and different stages of personal evolution. Each track reflects a distinct emotional space. 

REQUIEM moves through darker, melancholic and introspective territory. LEAP shifts toward fast, uplifting hard-trance energy and a sense of release, while Loud Enough brings bigger vocals, heavy bass and a more intense, dramatic club feel. 

Together, the tracks represent different phases, emotions and facets of the same journey, moving between tension, resilience, release and momentum while remaining rooted in a fast, emotionally charged sound.

Distributed by Label Engine - www.label-engine.com
results.name: PHASES EP

item.desc: We couldn’t have our 10th birthday year conclude without a release from Activa and here he returns to VII with a slice of classy melodic trance in the form of Velorum. item.name: Velorum

item.desc:
Polish producers Jackob Roenald and Casper Salary join forces for Neirith, a smooth and uplifting trance track that carries a calm and confident glow from the very first moment. Their collaboration feels natural and intuitive, and the result is a production that moves forward with clarity and emotional warmth.

Neirith is built around a sublime plucky lead that gives the track its identity. It rises gently through the mix and creates a feeling of open space and quiet optimism. The rhythm section keeps everything moving with steady drive while soft melodic touches drift in and out like distant signals. The entire track feels clean, focused and beautifully balanced, the kind of uplifting trance that works in both early evening sets and peak time moments where the crowd wants something bright without excess.

This release shows exactly why these two producers are gaining attention. Neirith is smooth without being safe, emotional without being sentimental and uplifting without ever losing its cool. It stands as a confident collaboration that fits perfectly within the evolving sound of Yanada and highlights the strength of both artists as they continue to grow.
item.name: Neirith

item.desc:
Nitrous Oxide leads his new two track trance single with focus track Shadows (with Genie), alongside Critical Point (with Adam Sobiech).

A pioneering figure among Polish DJs, Poznan born Nitrous Oxide has been a leading name in European trance since his debut single North Pole/Frozen Dreams, drawing support from Above & Beyond, Armin van Buuren and regular Beatport chart placements. Shadows, the focus track, features vocalist Genie, while Critical Point pairs him with fellow Polish trance producer Adam Sobiech, who broke through with 2014's Memories and has drawn backing from Armin van Buuren, Paul van Dyk, Gareth Emery, Above & Beyond and Cosmic Gate. Together the two tracks bring dancefloor size and melodic detail to Enhanced Progressive.

Distributed by Label Engine - www.label-engine.com
item.name: Shadows / Critical Point
